modules.title: Descriptive statistics, distributions and probability
modules.scope: mean, median, mode, standard deviation, standard error, normal distribution, skewness, confidence interval, probability, binomial distribution, Poisson distribution, central limit theorem, nominal ordinal interval data

modules.title: Hypothesis testing and choice of statistical test
modules.scope: null hypothesis, p value, type I alpha error, type II beta error, power, sample size calculation, t test, ANOVA, chi-square, Fisher exact, Mann-Whitney, Wilcoxon, Kruskal-Wallis, Bonferroni correction

modules.title: Correlation, regression and survival analysis
modules.scope: Pearson correlation, Spearman correlation, linear regression, logistic regression odds ratio, Cox proportional hazards, hazard ratio, Kaplan-Meier curve, log rank test, multivariable adjustment, competing risks

sections.title: Research methodology and evidence based medicine

modules.title: Study designs and epidemiological measures
modules.scope: cohort study, case control study, cross sectional, ecological, randomized controlled trial, relative risk, odds ratio, attributable risk, number needed to treat, incidence, prevalence, selection bias, confounding, Bradford Hill criteria

modules.title: Diagnostic test evaluation
modules.scope: sensitivity, specificity, positive predictive value, negative predictive value, likelihood ratio, ROC curve AUC, pretest probability, Bayes theorem, Fagan nomogram, screening lead time bias, length time bias

modules.title: Clinical trials, meta-analysis and research ethics
modules.scope: randomization, allocation concealment, blinding, intention to treat, per protocol analysis, noninferiority margin, CONSORT, systematic review, forest plot, I squared heterogeneity, funnel plot, GRADE, ICMR ethical guidelines, CTRI registration
